look.speaker: MARCEL
lines: This is him? Since last night?

henri_vouch.speaker: HENRI
lines: Since last night. He does what he is told.

rules.speaker: MARCEL
lines: Look at me, American. If we are stopped, you are Jean Caillet, my cousin, deaf and mute since a fever. You look at your shoes and you keep walking. Nothing in your pockets speaks English. Understood?

choices.text: Where are we taking— where are we going?

nosy.speaker: MARCEL
lines: Where I take you. That is the whole of it. The less you carry in your head, the less they can take out of it.

route.speaker: MARCEL
lines: We keep to the hedgerows. We cross the road twice. If I stop, you stop. If I drop, you drop into the ditch and you become the ditch.

farewell.speaker: HENRI
lines: Bonne chance, l'Américain. Perhaps you will remember there was bread here.
